claims.value: Jamba Large 1.7 is an open model in the Jamba family, featuring a novel SSM-Transformer hybrid architecture, 256K context window, and improvements in grounding and instruction-following.
claims.evidence: This new version builds on the novel SSM-Transformer hybrid architecture, 256K context window, and efficiency gains of previous versions, while introducing improvements in grounding and instruction-following.
Supported languages: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, German, Arabic and Hebrew
